note: The gear-tooth D draws its circuit traces on load (SVG stroke-dashoffset, staggered, pure CSS). The traces are the academy's thesis: Detroit builds, and the build leaves traces. Reduced-motion users get the finished state instantly.
title: Forge D mark + circuit traces

note: Headlines use a clamp()-based type scale (--step--1 through --step-3). No breakpoints for type — it flows. text-wrap: balance keeps the two-line hero from stranding a word.
title: Fluid type scale

note: A real interactive moment, not a video: visitors type commands and the training bot obeys. The most-tried commands will show up in telemetry — that's the engagement signal worth watching.
title: Try-it terminal

note: Each phase rail carries a light beam animated through a registered @property (--beam). Impossible in CSS before @property — the demo IS the feature. The beam means momentum: audience, sponsorship, advisory flywheel.
title: Trajectory rails + @property beam

note: Sections reveal on animation-timeline: view() — zero JavaScript where supported, IntersectionObserver fallback where not. The site deletes code to prove the point.
title: Scroll-driven reveals

note: Page changes crossfade with the brand mark held as a shared element (view-transition-name). No framework, no SPA — the logo stays planted while the page turns.
title: Cross-document view transitions
